name: creative-origin-engine
description: Multi-agent debate-driven creative decision engine. Three independent AI agents (Builder/Deconstructor/Data-Anchor) analyze in parallel, then Critic+Defender cross-validate, producing an executable plan scored on a 20-point scale. Use when user asks for 策划/方案/创意/活动策划/IP孵化/创业验证.
description_zh: 多Agent并行辩论式创意决策引擎。输入模糊创意→三Agent(建构/解构/数据锚定)并行分析→Critic+Defender双验证→20分制量化评分→可执行策划案+Agent Skill双格式输出。适用于文创策划、IP孵化、创业验证、商业模式设计。
description_en: Multi-agent debate-driven creative decision engine with 20-point quantitative scoring and Skill export.
